description.value: Ngon is a Vietnamese café on Kingsway specializing in banh mi sandwiches, rice and vermicelli bowls, and an extensive lineup of Vietnamese coffees — from classic drip with condensed milk to signature salted cream and coconut blended variations. The café also carries a full bubble tea and fresh smoothie menu, and a dedicated Halal menu section broadens its appeal. It makes a well-rounded stop for a hearty sandwich and a sweet drink on a longer ride through East Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 34m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 43m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 44m; stands (4 spaces) at 51m; stands (4 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 81m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business at 2228 Kingsway, Vancouver BC V5N 2T7, with the same phone number as OSM (+16044286220). However, the website consistently uses the brand name 'Ngon Cafe Vancouver' rather than the OSM name 'Ngon Banh Mi & Tea', which is flagged as a concern. Vegan options are explicitly confirmed via menu items ('Vegan Banh Mi', 'Vegan Bowl'); no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Ngon Banh Mi & Tea' but the website consistently uses 'Ngon Cafe Vancouver' as the trading name.
Online delivery and takeaway is currently suspended per the website ('Delivery and takeaway is disable now. please wait sometime').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active website with a full menu confirms this is a real, open restaurant at the listed Kingsway address with a broad food and drink offering suitable for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website footer lists an email address not present in OSM: owner@eatngon.com.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegan Banh Mi (New)' with marinated tofu and shiitake mushroom, 'Vegan Bowl' with tofu and vegan spring roll, and a 'Spring Roll (2pcs) Pork or Vegan' option

wow_evidence: Vietnamese café specializing in banh mi and extensive Vietnamese coffees including signature salted cream and coconut variations
